goal.text: Keep today's lands in place and bring everyone out of the great opening.

plate.narration: You are back on the glacier where it all began. The ice is blue and quiet and enormous. Even the wind has stopped to listen.

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, curious and practical. Short sentences. Show the consequence of each plan. Nobody dies.

npcVoices.Corvane: An old faun ruler, courtly, patient and confused. Certain about his remembered map, bewildered by today. Never threatens children. Short sentences. No conquer, punish, servants, destroy or hurt.
npcVoices.Orin Vale: Griffin scholar, practical and patient. Makes room for uncertainty.
npcVoices.Seren Wisp: Kitsune teacher. Holds conditions, never changes a rift's intrinsic rules.

arrival.narration: The walking passage opens above deep glacier ice. A great tear in the air shows pieces of distant ground sliding past one another. Orin Vale, the griffin scholar, and Seren Wisp, the kitsune teacher, stop behind your party. Farther in, a tall figure bends over an old map. "Keep today's lands in place," Orin says. "And bring everyone out of that opening." A loose ribbon on the map keeps trying to stand straight up.

variants.text: Olivia follows you into the passage and waits on the safe ice, ready to help hold a brace when you need her.
A builder from the sheltered hollow brings the wyrm along the broad walking passage. They stop beside the outer ice rib. Her low signal will tell it when to brace that edge.

retreat.narration: The walking passage gives you a broad way back. "A handline gathers us by touch if we fall back," says Orin. "Bright cloth marks we follow by sight. Pick one." Loose edges stay outside both routes. Neither line goes around a traveler.

choices.label: Pass a handline along the inside wall
Observe and place the cloth route marks

retreat_line.narration: Pass the guide line beside the solid inside wall. Orin fixes the sheltered end under a folded blanket. His boot has been excused from paperweight duty.

interaction.cue: Pass the guide line along the inside wall.

onSuccess.narration: The handline marks a continuous checked route.

onFailure.narration: The handline marks a continuous checked route.

onAssisted.narration: The handline marks a continuous checked route.

retreat_marks.narration: Watch Seren point out wall, rib, passage, wall. Echo the route marks before placing the cloths. A missed pattern gets a watcher-led route, not a guessed edge.

interaction.cue: Watch the safe-route marks, then echo them.

onSuccess.narration: Your checked cloth sequence marks the route back.

onFailure.narration: Seren will lead the marker placement from checked ground.

onAssisted.narration: Seren will lead the marker placement from checked ground.

retreat_help.narration: Pass the cloths to Seren along the inside wall. She checks each position from traveler height; the record names her route help.

interaction.cue: Pass the cloth markers to Seren.

onSuccess.narration: The watcher-led cloth route is checked.

onFailure.narration: The watcher-led cloth route is checked.

onAssisted.narration: The watcher-led cloth route is checked.

voices.narration: The tall figure looks from an old river on his map to a river through the tear. "Why is it on that side of the mountain?" From behind the boundary, choose a way to make today's people visible to him.

choices.label: Name homes beside the present river
Ask Orin to show the present map
Point out people steadying one another

reveal.narration: The figure steps into view: an enormous faun with a long mustache tied back by a faded ribbon. "I am Corvane," he says. "Emperor of Pangea. Do you know how long I waited to see my rivers run the right way again?" Pangea was his realm, with the lands arranged like the old places you learned about on your road. The glacier held him until the mountain's tremors changed the melt and loosened his prison. He is pulling the places back to his old map, moving the homes built there since.

map_shelter.narration: Corvane's old map snaps upward in a gust. "Mind the corners," he says. Keep it in a dry case, or spread it beside today's map where he can compare both at once. The open page needs a careful corner catch; a miss can blur fine old marks. The case protects those marks, but must be unpacked for a later side-by-side conversation.

choices.label: Pass the old map into the dry case
Catch the old map corner beside the present map

map_case.narration: Corvane releases the loose map corner. You slide the old drawing into its case from sound ice. His present map stays open beside it. He keeps one hand on the case for a moment, then lets you set it down.

map_shelter_check.narration: Guide the old map's loose corner under a smooth weight beside the present map. Corvane frees his ribbon before anyone sets the stone. His map has applied for a flying license.

interaction.cue: Catch the old map corner inside the dry interval.

onSuccess.narration: Both maps stay visible on sound ice.

onFailure.narration: Slush reaches the old map corner before the weight settles.

onAssisted.narration: Orin helps settle the corner dry. Both maps remain visible.

map_shelter_changed.narration: You set the damp corner flat and leave it to dry. A few fine marks have blurred. Orin keeps the rest clear and records the damage honestly.

remember.narration: Your two checked accounts show places as they lie now, with people living there. "Lead the first anchor with a place you truly learned," Orin says. "Or I can guide your checked notes." The original memories and stones remain with their keepers.

choices.label: Have Orin guide the first checked account
Recall the river view from the memory readers

remember_guided.narration: Hold the first checked account while Orin points to its present place. The other checked page waits apart. You are beginning one anchor, not claiming a third discovery.

interaction.cue: Hold the first checked page for Orin.

onSuccess.narration: One present outline slows the sliding ground.

onFailure.narration: One present outline slows the sliding ground.

onAssisted.narration: One present outline slows the sliding ground.

remember_paths.narration: Watch Orin point to the copied river, the present path and the gap you never observed. Echo the pointing round without filling that gap. The memory stayed with the readers in their old ice.

interaction.cue: Echo the checked river-account pointing round.

onSuccess.narration: The remembered account steadies its present outline.

onFailure.narration: Keep the page where Orin can check the account with you.

onAssisted.narration: Keep the page where Orin can check the account with you.

remember_coast.narration: Follow your marked bridge drawing as Orin separates it from the covered present-map sheets. The bridge stone stayed on its bank; your copy is what you use here.

interaction.cue: Follow the marked bridge drawing through the sheets.

onSuccess.narration: The checked bridge account steadies its present outline.

onFailure.narration: Orin uncovers the bridge copy and helps check its present place.

onAssisted.narration: Orin uncovers the bridge copy and helps check its present place.

remember_sky.narration: Guide the copied boundary edge beside the present island outline. Use only the groove your party checked; the original mooring stone stayed on the island.

interaction.cue: Align the checked copied boundary edge.

onSuccess.narration: The checked island account steadies its present outline.

onFailure.narration: The fine edge slipped. Orin helps use the broad checked outline.

onAssisted.narration: The fine edge slipped. Orin helps use the broad checked outline.

anchor_help.narration: Support the checked page while Orin names the present place with you. The account is helped, not invented. No missing stretch is repaired by saying it louder.

interaction.cue: Support the account for Orin's check.

onSuccess.narration: The checked present outline holds after the extra help.

onFailure.narration: The checked present outline holds after the extra help.

onAssisted.narration: The checked present outline holds after the extra help.

first_anchor.narration: Keep that first page steady while a friend traces a different checked place on the present map. The two accounts stay apart. Corvane watches homes and walking paths. "My old map left those out," he murmurs.

interaction.cue: Hold the first page while a friend traces the other checked place.

onSuccess.narration: The two present outlines hold while two parts of the opening fold inward.

onFailure.narration: The two present outlines hold while two parts of the opening fold inward.

onAssisted.narration: The two present outlines hold while two parts of the opening fold inward.

first_anchor_clear.narration: Two parts of the great opening close. The ground stops sliding toward the old map. "The last seam is still pulling," Seren says.

rest.narration: Orin opens the supper bag he brought from camp. You sit inside a solid ice rib and share dried apples while Seren pours warm water from her flask. Orin checks his boot for a lost apple ring. "It has been a long day for this boot," he says.

shelter.narration: Behind a solid ice rib, a yeti watcher has warm broth, a lamp and spare blankets. "I will keep the retreat open," she says. "I will not go into the tear." Seren shows the ridge brace inside the safe line. Holding that ridge steadies a condition; it cannot change a destination. Your party must choose where to spend its preparation.

hold_condition.narration: Fit the ridge brace now to shorten the board's closing job from four working turns to three, or set a broad rescue-lamp station to widen the recovery interval if you lose the fight. You have time to prepare one. Both leave a checked way back. A starweaver can fit the brace with Seren without the separate balancing job.

choices.label: Level the ridge brace for a shorter board job
Have our starweaver hold the ridge with Seren

hold_condition_check.narration: Level the padded brace against the marked ridge point from sound ice. The retreat line stays separate. Seren checks the condition before the party approaches the board.

interaction.cue: Level the ridge brace at its marked point.

onSuccess.narration: The fitted brace offers a three-turn close on the board.

onFailure.narration: The fitted brace offers a three-turn close on the board.

onAssisted.narration: The fitted brace offers a three-turn close on the board.

hold_condition_3.narration: Your starweaver holds the ridge condition while Seren checks the marked point. The party can skip the separate brace-balancing job. The prepared three-turn close is available on the board; the seam keeps its own rules.

rescue_station.narration: Pass the lamp and broad sight markers to the watcher inside the ice rib. The wider view will help a later recovery attempt; it does not close the seam or remove a crawler.

interaction.cue: Pass the rescue-lamp kit to the watcher.

onSuccess.narration: The broad rescue station is prepared.

onFailure.narration: The broad rescue station is prepared.

onAssisted.narration: The broad rescue station is prepared.

anchors.narration: The two places you described hold the land against the pull. Corvane grips the last seam, and crawlers gather beside it. "One more steady support would fold the opening thinner," Orin says. "Then he has less room to pull." Choose a support, or keep Orin and Seren ready on the rescue lane.

choices.label: Keep Orin and Seren on the rescue lane
Ask the allied wyrm to hold the loose ice
Ask Olivia to help anchor the present land

standard_plan.narration: Orin and Seren stay beside the watcher on the rescue lane. Two learned places hold the great opening broken. Corvane still stands strongly beside the last seam, with two displaced crawlers. Your reserve team will help everyone recover if the fight goes badly.

third_plan.narration: The third checked account is ready beside the other two. Work its support into the present map before the encounter. It is another place you learned, not an object taken from it.

wyrm_plan.narration: The allied wyrm waits with its builder at the outer ice rib. Help give the low signal and keep the loose edge clear so it can brace outside the working lane.

olivia_plan.narration: Olivia offers her help from the safe brace point. "A condition," she says, "not a command." Work from Seren's observed hold-and-ease signals; Olivia will follow your checked call.

third_account.narration: You name the unused checked account and point to its present place. Seren checks the match before anyone sets the support. The third account adds its own view; it does not replace either of the first two.

wyrm_support.narration: Hold the builder's signal cloth steady while she calls the wyrm. It curls against the loose outer ice, outside your party's working lane. Nobody orders it into the tear.

interaction.cue: Hold the builder's signal cloth at the outer rib.

onSuccess.narration: The wyrm braces the outer edge. The tear narrows; one crawler slips home.

onFailure.narration: The wyrm braces the outer edge. The tear narrows; one crawler slips home.

onAssisted.narration: The wyrm braces the outer edge. The tear narrows; one crawler slips home.

olivia_support.narration: Seren demonstrates hold, ease, hold. Echo that round for Olivia from the marked brace. If it is missed, Seren will lead instead of making Olivia follow a guess.

interaction.cue: Echo the brace signals for Olivia.

onSuccess.narration: Olivia follows the checked round. The tear narrows; one crawler slips home.

onFailure.narration: Keep the brace steady while Seren leads the signals.

onAssisted.narration: Keep the brace steady while Seren leads the signals.

olivia_help.narration: Support the marked brace while Seren gives Olivia the visible hold-and-ease calls. The support still works; the account credits Seren's lead.

interaction.cue: Support the brace for Seren's calls.

onSuccess.narration: Olivia and Seren finish the extra support. One crawler slips home.

onFailure.narration: Olivia and Seren finish the extra support. One crawler slips home.

onAssisted.narration: Olivia and Seren finish the extra support. One crawler slips home.

support_ready.narration: The extra support has narrowed the tear. Corvane has less room to pull and one fewer crawler remains. Only this one support is used; other allies and accounts are not silently stacked.

fight_standard.narration: Corvane fights to keep the last seam open. Displaced bone crawlers crowd its fresh magic. Drive them back, or end four turns beside the ridge brace to close the seam. The marked retreat route stays behind you. Nobody needs to stand in the pulling tear.

objectives.label: Hold the ridge and close the last seam

fight_standard_braced.narration: Corvane fights to keep the last seam open. Displaced bone crawlers crowd its fresh magic. Drive them back, or end three turns beside the ridge brace to close the seam. The marked retreat route stays behind you. Nobody needs to stand in the pulling tear.

objectives.label: Hold the ridge and close the last seam

fight_weakened.narration: Corvane fights to keep the last seam open. Displaced bone crawlers crowd its fresh magic. Drive them back, or end four turns beside the ridge brace to close the seam. The marked retreat route stays behind you. Nobody needs to stand in the pulling tear.

objectives.label: Hold the ridge and close the last seam

fight_weakened_braced.narration: Corvane fights to keep the last seam open. Displaced bone crawlers crowd its fresh magic. Drive them back, or end three turns beside the ridge brace to close the seam. The marked retreat route stays behind you. Nobody needs to stand in the pulling tear.

objectives.label: Hold the ridge and close the last seam

spent.narration: The last seam closes. Corvane lowers his hands, his strength spent. The remaining crawlers slip away from the fading magic. The glacier grows quiet enough to hear the ribbon fall against the old map. "It was a very good map," he says. Orin keeps the retreat lane open while the yeti watcher comes to meet you.

variants.text: Your party held the condition until the seam closed. Corvane did not need to be knocked down to lose his hold on it.
The blurred corner of the old map is still drying. Orin leaves that patch blank in his copy until Corvane can help explain the missing marks.

help_him.narration: The watcher brings a blanket large enough for Corvane. His mustache has escaped its ribbon, and he looks like someone who has been cold for a very long time. "Ask before you wrap or move him," the watcher says softly.

choices.label: Set the blanket within his reach

home_now.narration: The land has stopped moving. "Where did my river go?" Corvane asks. The watcher can describe her valley from memory, or you can set the two maps beside each other. A cased old map must be unpacked first; a wet corner still has missing fine marks.

variants.text: Some places have already shifted. You mark what still needs checking instead of promising that the whole map is right.

choices.label: Ask the watcher about her present valley
Unpack the old map for comparison

unpack_map.narration: Corvane opens the old case himself at the sound table. You leave room beside the present map. The dry old drawing can be read here without pulling anything through the tear. He smooths one corner with the back of his hand.

home_maps.narration: You place a broad pointer beside the present river and the homes along it. Corvane follows the line. His old drawing lies open nearby. For once he looks at the people's marks on the new map before checking the old one.

home_watcher.narration: The watcher names her walking path and the room where yetis read memories in old ice. Choose a useful question for Corvane to hear about the living valley. Nobody redraws a route they have not checked.

choices.label: Ask who uses the reading room

fate.narration: The yetis offer two safe futures. Corvane can return to a quiet chamber in the ice, where his memory will be kept while he rests. Or he can live with the yetis and learn the names of the world now. He looks at the open walking path, then at the quiet ice. Your party may choose with him.

choices.label: Keep him and his memory in the quiet ice
Ask him to live with the yetis and learn

keepers.narration: The yetis make a quiet place in the ice. Corvane folds his map and steps inside beneath his blanket. "Wake me if the rivers ever forget their way." The ice keeps him, and he keeps the memory. The land stays still. In the records of the glacier, your party is called the Glacier Keepers.

variants.text: The displaced places settle back toward their present homes. The paths your party knew are there again.
You stopped the last pull after falling back, but some places remain shifted. The watchers mark those routes for checking. Keeping the rest safe has left a scar on the map.

listened.narration: Corvane sits at a broad table with the yetis who read memories in the old ice with the present map before him. "Then tell me what you call this valley now." The watcher begins with the path outside the door. He listens. The land stays still. In the records of the glacier, your party is called the Ones Who Listened.

variants.text: The displaced places settle back toward their present homes. The paths your party knew are there again.
You stopped the last pull after falling back, but some places remain shifted. The watchers mark those routes for checking. Keeping the rest safe has left a scar on the map.

keepers_epilogue.narration: The Riftseekers write down the places your party helped and the choices that changed the route. The chime hangs beside a plain walking door. When you leave, the watcher opens that door by hand. A small goat outside immediately tries to eat its welcome mat.

variants.text: Olivia joins Orin at the study table. She records each test before proposing the next one.
Olivia helps the watchers hold the last loose ground. She writes the result before proposing her next experiment.
Olivia packs her notebook and takes an open walking path to continue her own study elsewhere.
The builders keep the sheltered hollow open. Their neighbor answers with a low rumble when they pass.
Later, a temple message reports the landing repairs. The broken boards were real; so was the shelter your party helped make.
Later, the temple keepers watch the returned island drift gently clear as the lands settle home. The new boundary taught them where to keep their next watch.
Pip stays with Bram on the safe side of the working line. He checks the next signal before following it.
Pip follows Olivia, carrying a copy of the retreat signal in his notebook.

Pip stays with Bram on the safe side of the working line. He checks the next signal before following it.
Pip follows Olivia, carrying a copy of the retreat signal in his notebook.

rivers_wander.narration: The Riftseekers spread out to watch the changed routes. Some lands remain jumbled for now; the party's work still brought everyone safely out. In the glacier records, this account is called Rivers Wander. Orin folds the useless joining lines under the new page. "Then we learn the new map." The watcher opens the ordinary door onto tomorrow.

loss_epilogue.narration: Your party rests while the first messengers set out. Every changed route will need checking, and the people you helped know how to begin. A small goat noses the closed map case, decides it is poor breakfast, and goes looking for a welcome mat instead.

variants.text: Olivia joins Orin at the study table. She records each test before proposing the next one.
Olivia helps the watchers hold the last loose ground. She writes the result before proposing her next experiment.
Olivia packs her notebook and takes an open walking path to continue her own study elsewhere.
The builders keep the sheltered hollow open. Their neighbor answers with a low rumble when they pass.
Pip stays with Bram on the safe side of the working line. He checks the next signal before following it.
Pip follows Olivia, carrying a copy of the retreat signal in his notebook.

loss_second_failed.narration: Orin and Seren bring everyone off the brace along the marked lane. The watcher closes the shelter against the flying snow. The last pull falters and the opening fades, but more lands have moved. No one returns for another attempt tonight. Corvane follows the watcher out, carrying a map that no longer fits.

loss_recover.narration: Your party falls back to the watcher behind the ice rib. Orin and Seren bring everyone clear; the watcher opens her blankets and broth. Some places have already shifted. Any extra support has spent its strength, and the last seam still pulls. From the rescue lane you have one different attempt left: use the pause in the pull to set the ridge brace. You can ask for an untimed helping hand.

loss_watch.narration: Everyone is safe with the watcher. Before the different brace attempt, mark the crew's working limit on the rescue lane. Your prepared handline or checked cloths can help; the watcher's lamp is always available. Nobody returns to the board fight.

choices.label: Gather everyone by the watcher's lamp
Support the brace crew with our prepared handline
Show the brace station from our checked cloth marks

loss_lamp.narration: Pass the watcher's lamp from the passage to the first safe station. Orin keeps the map behind it while Seren watches for the pull's pause.

interaction.cue: Pass the shelter lamp to the safe station.

onSuccess.narration: The lamp marks the rescue-lane limit.

onFailure.narration: The lamp marks the rescue-lane limit.

onAssisted.narration: The lamp marks the rescue-lane limit.

loss_line.narration: Support the prepared handline beside the inside wall while Seren checks the brace crew's working limit from the watcher's shelter. No loop goes around anyone, and nobody steps into the opening.

interaction.cue: Support the prepared handline from sound ice.

onSuccess.narration: The handline marks the brace crew's safe working limit.

onFailure.narration: The handline marks the brace crew's safe working limit.

onAssisted.narration: The handline marks the brace crew's safe working limit.

loss_marks.narration: Echo the route marks you checked: wall, rib, passage, wall. Use them to show the watcher which safe station the brace crew will use. A missed pattern uses her lamp instead of a guessed work point.

interaction.cue: Echo the checked cloth route to the watcher.

onSuccess.narration: The watcher can see the checked brace station from shelter.

onFailure.narration: Use the watcher-led lamp route rather than a guessed cloth sequence.

onAssisted.narration: Use the watcher-led lamp route rather than a guessed cloth sequence.

loss_anchor_plan.narration: The pull pauses beside the ridge. Orin guides the present map from the rescue lane; Seren helps hold the condition. Set the brace in the ordinary pause, or use the broad lamp interval if you prepared that rescue station. This attempt can close the seam or leave more lands shifted. Assistance is available before committing.

choices.label: Set the padded brace in the ordinary pause
Use our prepared broad rescue interval
Use our reserve team's supported hold

loss_anchor_check.narration: Set the padded ridge brace from the rescue lane during the pause. The ordinary target is narrower; the prepared rescue station gives a broader view. An untimed helping hand lets Seren guide the brace with you.

interaction.cue: Set the ridge brace during the safe pause.

onSuccess.narration: The brace holds and the seam folds shut. Some places have already shifted.

onFailure.narration: The ridge slips. Seren calls release and everyone draws back to the watcher.

onAssisted.narration: The brace holds and the seam folds shut. Some places have already shifted.

loss_anchor_supported.narration: Set the padded ridge brace from the rescue lane during the pause. The ordinary target is narrower; the prepared rescue station gives a broader view. An untimed helping hand lets Seren guide the brace with you.

interaction.cue: Set the ridge brace during the safe pause.

onSuccess.narration: The brace holds and the seam folds shut. Some places have already shifted.

onFailure.narration: The ridge slips. Seren calls release and everyone draws back to the watcher.

onAssisted.narration: The brace holds and the seam folds shut. Some places have already shifted.

loss_anchor_reserved.narration: Orin and Seren stayed on the rescue lane as your reserve team. Hold their padded support steady while they set the ridge together from sound ice. This is a supported closing job, not another board fight or a timed guess.

interaction.cue: Support the reserve team's padded brace.

onSuccess.narration: The brace holds and the seam folds shut. Some places have already shifted.

onFailure.narration: The brace holds and the seam folds shut. Some places have already shifted.

onAssisted.narration: The brace holds and the seam folds shut. Some places have already shifted.

voices_response_homes.narration: He looks beyond the river line for the first time. The figure steps where you can see him clearly.

voices_response_map.narration: He leans toward the page without stepping nearer your party. The figure steps where you can see him clearly.

voices_response_people.narration: He follows your hand toward the living shore. The figure steps where you can see him clearly.

help_him_response_blanket.narration: He takes the blanket and gathers it around his shoulders. The watcher keeps the same safe path open for everyone.

help_him_response_path.narration: The watcher waits for him to choose to stand. The watcher keeps the same safe path open for everyone.

help_him_response_ribbon.narration: He holds out the loose end instead of reaching toward the closed seam. The watcher keeps the same safe path open for everyone.

home_watcher_response_path.narration: The watcher starts with the ordinary path outside her door. The watcher finishes her account. Corvane leaves the map lines alone.

home_watcher_response_room.narration: She describes the readers carrying their own notes. The watcher finishes her account. Corvane leaves the map lines alone.

home_watcher_response_home.narration: Corvane listens to names his old map never held. The watcher finishes her account. Corvane leaves the map lines alone.
